subject: Damaged cartons on delivery DL-4471
body: Three of the eight cartons on delivery DL-4471 arrived crushed and two bottles inside were leaking. This is the second time this month. We need replacements or a refund, and I want to speak to a manager.

subject: Delivery days for Mombasa route
body: Could you tell me which days you deliver to the Mombasa route? We are planning our stock for December and need to know the cut-off for orders.

subject: Quotation for 40 cases of 500ml water
body: Please send a quotation for 40 cases of 500ml water delivered to our shop in Karen. We would also like to know your payment terms for a first order.

subject: Invoice INV-2291 overcharged
body: Invoice INV-2291 shows 60 cases but we only received 50. We have been charged for stock we never got. Please correct the invoice and issue a credit note.

subject: Thank you
body: Thank you to the driver who helped us unload on Tuesday. Great service, we appreciate the extra effort.

subject: Order status
body: Where is my order? It was supposed to arrive on Monday and nobody has called me.

subject: URGENT stock out
body: URGENT. We are completely out of the 1 litre bottles and we have a catering order tomorrow morning. This is critical for us, please respond immediately.

subject: Account
body: Hi, it is about the thing we discussed last week regarding our account setup. Let me know.

subject: Price list
body: Please send the current price list for the 500ml and 1.5 litre lines. We are reviewing suppliers for next quarter.

subject: Allergic reaction
body: My customer had a reaction after drinking from one of the bottles in our last delivery. We need this looked at urgently and we are considering legal advice.
